data.narrative:
Cellares is a Series C-stage biotech company that has raised $350M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, with particular weight on same-stage private companies including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to a $12M base value derived from total capital raised, implying a $20M valuation. Peer-median anchoring across the three same-sector, same-stage comparables yields a $3.8B median valuation, with a $3.1B floor and $10.3B ceiling. Public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of disclosed revenue for the target company.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $17M to $4.4B, with a median of $1.9B across the two applicable methods. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty: the stage-progression method (weighted toward early raised capital) anchors substantially below peer medians, which themselves span a 3.3x range. Key drivers of valuation uncertainty include Cellares' progress toward inflection milestones relative to peers, the capital efficiency implied by its $350M+ raise, and technology risk in an early-stage biotech context. Resolution of competitive positioning versus the identified peer set would narrow this range materially.
